text:
emma: Quick heads up, the new Next starter that wires LangChain adapters is failing a few things in local runs. Anyone else run into missing telemetry or spiky 401s?
raj: I can repro. Steps: clone repo, yarn, NEXTAUTH disabled, start dev, create an agent with `new RedwoodClient({ key: process.env.RW_KEY })` and call `agent.run(...)`. No telemetry event for `agent.run`.
sofia: Is this the adapter that uses LlamaIndex as a chain? We changed the SDK agent wrapper last week for parity.
mike: Reproduced here too. Also saw quick successive requests hit 401 until SDK backoff recovers. Logs: `ERR: 401 unauthorized - token expired` then `sdk: retrying in 1200ms` repeated.
emma: Minimal repro lives in the starter under `pages/api/agent.ts`. Python starter reports telemetry correctly, JS one seems to skip instrumentation.
raj: Quick code scan: the JS modular agent adapter doesn't call `telemetry.trackEvent` before invoking the model path. I can open a small PR to wire that.
sofia: We should confirm parity vs starter wiring bug. Might be middleware not passing telemetry context.
mike: I left a comment in the starter. The helper that wires plugins omits `telemetryContext`. Quick fix: `agent.options.telemetryContext = getTelemetryCtx(req)` but that's a fragile patch.
emma: Token rotation root cause: console plugin rotates tokens and our runtime fetch wrapper sometimes fails to propagate the refreshed token into the existing LLM client instance, so the next call gets 401 then retries.
raj: So two issues: (1) telemetry hookup for modular path; (2) token propagation on rotation. I can take (1).
sofia: I'll own (2) in the SDK fetch adapter. Plan is to ensure the adapter reads a token provider per-request rather than caching env var on init. I'll add unit + integration tests.
ci-bot: created issue #DE-487: "modular-agent starter: telemetry missing & auth token stale after rotation" assigned to @raj @sofia.
mike: Temporary workaround for dev users: recreate the Redwood client per-request in Next API so it picks up current token env. Not ideal but avoids immediate 401s.
emma: Agreed. Add a note to the starter README warning about auth rotation and link the issue.
raj: PR opened: #1284 12 16 telemetry hook added to modular-agent adapter and a unit that asserts `telemetry.trackEvent` fired.
sofia: Working branch for token propagation tests. I'm extending the eval harness to simulate token rotation and assert no 401 after rotation. Will push GH Action matrix (node 18/20) so we catch parity issues early.
mike: Also proposal: include `sdk.clientId` (opt-in) in telemetry events to tie starter sessions to flows.
emma: We'll add opt-in env `RW_TELEMETRY_OPT_IN=true` and document privacy in README.
sofia: Sharing quick repro script in issue: ```bash
# repro token rotation 401
export RW_KEY=old
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/rotate-token -d '{}'
# immediate call to agent endpoint
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/agent -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```
raj: After both fixes merge, cherry-pick into the release branch and update the quickstart template used by onboarding so users get the patched starter.
emma: Thanks. Tagging @devex to include a small blurb in release notes and update starter docs.
mike: :thumbsup: 
sofia: I'll leave notes in the issue with test results and link to the eval harness job id when it's green.
emma: Closing the loop once PRs are merged. Good catch everyone.
